name: Starfield of Nyx — gated on 'you control five or more enchantments'
notes: Memory: project_youcontrol_count_condition_2026-04-08. The threshold condition was unparsed, so Starfield animated enchantments unconditionally. Here the controller has only 4 enchantments (Starfield, Rhystic Study, Sylvan Library, Phyrexian Arena) while the opponent controls 2 more (6 globally), so the condition is unmet and nothing may become a creature.
